name: @hasna/machines
description: Machine fleet management CLI + MCP for developers

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/cli/index.ts --outdir dist/cli --target bun --external @hasna/events --external @hasna/events/* --external @hasna/contracts --external @hasna/contracts/* --external pg && bun build src/mcp/index.ts --outdir dist/mcp --target bun --external @hasna/events --external @hasna/events/* --external @modelcontextprotocol/sdk --external pg && bun build src/agent/index.ts --outdir dist/agent --target bun && bun build src/server/index.ts --outdir dist/server --target bun --external @hasna/events --external @hasna/events/* --external @hasna/contracts --external @hasna/contracts/* --external pg && bun build src/sdk/index.ts --outdir dist/sdk --target bun && bun build src/index.ts src/storage.ts src/consumer.ts --outdir dist --target bun --external @hasna/events --external @hasna/events/* --external @hasna/contracts --external @hasna/contracts/* --external pg && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist
scripts.verify:release: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build && bun run smoke:consumer-conformance && bun run scripts/verify-release.ts
